build_HalvingGridSearchCV: build a hyperparameter search using HalvingGridSearchCV with a param_grid and resource='n_estimators'
create_HalvingRandomSearchCV: create a randomized hyperparameter search using HalvingRandomSearchCV with param_distributions and max_resources
run_successive_halving_fit: run successive halving search on an estimator with cross-validation and iterative resource allocation
test_top_k_selection: test the _top_k function that selects the best candidates from iteration results by mean_test_score
review_BaseSuccessiveHalving_fit: review the BaseSuccessiveHalving.fit method that validates cv consistency and runs the iterative search loop
